author: Brandon Sanderson
synopsis: In a land where ash falls from the sky and a god-emperor has ruled for a thousand years, a street urchin named Vin discovers she can draw power from swallowed metals. She is recruited by a charismatic survivor, Kelsier, and his crew of thieves for an audacious plan to topple the empire.
notes: Era 1 trilogy, finished. Goodreads groups all eras as one Mistborn Saga; Era 3 (Ghostbloods) is expected from 2028 and a later Era 4 is planned.

author: Brandon Sanderson
synopsis: On the storm-battered world of Roshar, a surgeon's son turned slave soldier, a young scholar with a secret, and a warlord troubled by visions are pulled into a long war on the Shattered Plains. Ancient oaths and bonds with spren are stirring again, hinting that the legendary Knights Radiant, and the catastrophe they once fought, may be returning.
notes: 5 published; 10 planned in two five-book arcs. No book 6 title or date announced as of 2026-09; Sanderson is on a planned break from the series.

author: Jim Butcher
synopsis: Harry Dresden is Chicago's only openly practising wizard, scraping by as a private investigator who consults for the police on crimes nobody else can explain. His first case pits him against a killer using black magic, while the wizards' council watches him for any slip.

author: Joe Abercrombie
synopsis: In a brutal world of failing kingdoms, a weary Northern barbarian, a crippled torturer serving the crown and a vain young officer are drawn into the schemes of an ancient, manipulative wizard. As war threatens on two borders, none of them is the hero they might seem.
notes: Original trilogy complete; later books in the same world are tracked as First Law standalones and The Age of Madness.

author: Patrick Rothfuss
synopsis: A quiet innkeeper in a remote village turns out to be Kvothe, a figure of legend, and he agrees to tell a travelling scribe the true story of his life. Over three days he recounts his childhood among travelling performers, years of survival on city streets, and his hunger to study at the University.

author: Steven Erikson
synopsis: The Malazan Empire is grinding through a long campaign of conquest, and its next target is Darujhistan, the last free city on its continent. Soldiers, assassins, mages and meddling gods all pursue their own aims, with the battered squad known as the Bridgeburners caught in the middle.

author: Pierce Brown
synopsis: On a terraformed Mars, society is split into rigid colour-coded castes, and Darrow is a Red miner who believes he is toiling to make the planet habitable. After learning how badly his people have been deceived, he is remade to pass as a Gold and sent into the ruling class's ruthless academy to bring it down from inside.
